summary: End-to-end UI+integration test of the two new Basketly features passed. Verified: (1) Admin creates analyst invite -> invite link shown & row OPEN. (2) Signup via invite creates analyst -> lands on /admin Analyst Console. (3) Signup WITHOUT invite creates investor -> lands on /dashboard, no analyst-invite-banner. (4) Reusing the same invite is blocked with red toast 'This analyst invite is invalid, used or expired.' and stays on /signup. (5) Analyst 'New portfolio' + factsheet PDF upload -> factsheet-pdf-row and factsheet-pdf-link (with ?auth= token) appear, Save & submit for approval -> PENDING. (6) Admin approves via EXACT-text 'Approve' button in 'Listings (approve)' tab -> status flips to APPROVED. (7) Public (logged-out) /model-portfolios/<id> shows Overview 'Factsheet' card with data-testid=factsheet-download linking to /api/portfolios/<id>/factsheet; fetch without auth returns 200 with Content-Type application/pdf (437 bytes).

issues: After clicking sidebar tabs (e.g., 'Analyst invites', 'Listings (approve)'), the page heading still reads 'Content manager' / 'Edit what investors see... Publish changes' with an active 'Publish changes' button that is unrelated to the current tab. Consider updating the header per active tab for clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminPage top header ('Content manager' + Publish changes) is rendered for all sidebar tabs (invites, listings, leads, etc.). It should be tab-specific to avoid misleading users into clicking 'Publish changes' when editing invites/listings.

factsheet-pdf-link in AnalystConsole includes the JWT in the URL query (?auth=<token>). This works but exposes the token in browser history/logs; consider a short-lived signed URL or Bearer-only download for owner/admin.
Admin login redirects to /dashboard by default; admins must manually navigate to /admin. Consider auto-routing role=admin to /admin post-login.
